---
title: "Weekly Bet Cheat Sheet"
output: html_document
params:
  bet_table: null
  survivor_teams: null
  depth_charts: null
  team_lookup_table: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(rvest)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)

clean_names = function(name)
{
  return(tolower(name) %>% str_remove_all("[[:punct:]]+") %>% str_remove("\\b(jr|sr|i{1,3}|iv|v|vi{1,3}|ix|x|xi{1,3})\\b") %>% str_squish() %>% trimws())
}




```


```{r}


depth_charts = params$depth_charts %>% select(Player, No, Position)


bettors = unique(params$bet_table$Bettor)
placed_bets = params$bet_table %>% mutate(clean = clean_names(Player)) %>%
  inner_join(depth_charts, join_by('clean' == 'Player')) %>%
  select(-clean)


placed_bets = placed_bets %>% filter(Gametime >= Sys.time() - 120*60)



url = paste0("https://www.pro-football-reference.com/years/", unique(placed_bets$Season), '/games.htm')
session = session(url, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/113.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"))
schedule_html = read_html(session)
schedule_table_node = schedule_html %>% html_node('table#games')
if (!inherits(schedule_table_node, "xml_missing"))
{
  schedule_table = schedule_table_node %>% html_table(fill = TRUE)
} else {
   schedule_table = NULL
}
games= schedule_table[schedule_table$Week == unique(placed_bets$Week),c(1,2,3,4,5,7)]  %>%
  mutate(Time = format(strptime(Time, "%I:%M%p"), "%H:%M"),
         posix_timestamp_game = as.POSIXct(paste(Date, Time), tz = "America/New_York")) %>%
  mutate(time_parsed = parse_date_time(Time, orders = c("I:Mp","I:M p","H:M")),
         Timeslot = paste(Day, case_when(hour(time_parsed) < 11 ~ 'Morning',
                                         hour(time_parsed) < 15 ~ 'Early Window',
                                         hour(time_parsed) < 19 ~ 'Late Window',
                                         TRUE ~ 'Night')))

if(length(params$survivor_teams) > 0)
{
  survivor_team_df = params$survivor_teams %>% data.frame()
  colnames(survivor_team_df) = 'Survivor_Team'
  survivor_team_df = survivor_team_df %>% inner_join(games %>% rename('Opp' = `Loser/tie`), join_by('Survivor_Team' == `Winner/tie`)) %>%
    rbind(survivor_team_df %>% inner_join(games %>% rename('Opp' = `Winner/tie`), join_by('Survivor_Team' == `Loser/tie`))) %>%
   select(Survivor_Team, Opp, Timeslot)
} else{
  survivor_team_df = NULL
}
    

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}

for (t in games %>% arrange(posix_timestamp_game) %>% select(Timeslot) %>% distinct() %>% pull())
{
  
  #count bets and survivor teams in this timeslot
  bets_this_timeslot = placed_bets %>% filter(Timeslot == t)
  if(!is.null(survivor_team_df) && nrow(survivor_team_df)> 0)
  {
    survivors_this_timeslot = survivor_team_df %>% filter(Timeslot == t)
  } else {
    survivors_this_timeslot = NULL
  }
  
  
  if(nrow(bets_this_timeslot) > 0 | (!is.null(survivors_this_timeslot) && nrow(survivors_this_timeslot) > 0)) #if there is at least one bet or survivor in this timeslot
  {
    print(tags$h1(t)) #main heading for the timeslot
    
    if(!is.null(survivors_this_timeslot) && nrow(survivors_this_timeslot) > 0) #survivor section
    {
      print(tags$h4(paste('Survivor Games:')))
      for(s in 1:nrow(survivors_this_timeslot))
      {
        print(tags$p(paste0(survivors_this_timeslot$Survivor_Team[s], ' (vs. ', survivors_this_timeslot$Opp[s], ')')))
      }
    }
 
    if(nrow(bets_this_timeslot) > 0) #bets section
    {
      bets_this_timeslot = bets_this_timeslot %>% left_join(params$team_lookup_table %>% select(FullName, Team) %>% rename('TeamFullName' = 'FullName'), join_by('Team')) %>%
         left_join(params$team_lookup_table %>% select(FullName, Team) %>% rename('OppFullName' = 'FullName'), join_by('Opp' == 'Team'))
      
      bets_this_timeslot = bets_this_timeslot %>% mutate(game = paste(pmin(TeamFullName, OppFullName),
                                                           pmax(TeamFullName, OppFullName),
                                                           sep = " - ")) %>% arrange(Team)
    
      
      for(g in unique(bets_this_timeslot$game))
      {
        print(tags$h4(paste(g, 'Bets')))
        this_game = bets_this_timeslot %>% filter(game == g)
        players_this_game = this_game %>% group_by(Player, Bet_Type, Label) %>% summarise(Bettors = paste(Bettor, collapse = ","), TeamFullName = max(TeamFullName), Number = max(No), Position = max(Position)) %>% arrange(TeamFullName)
        for(p in 1:nrow(players_this_game))
        {
          print(tags$p(paste0(ifelse(length(bettors) > 1, paste0(players_this_game$Bettors[p], ": "), ''), players_this_game$Player[p], ' (', players_this_game$TeamFullName[p],', ', players_this_game$Position[p], ' #', players_this_game$Number[p], ') -- ', players_this_game$Bet_Type[p], ifelse(players_this_game$Bet_Type[p] == 'Anytime TD Scorer', '', players_this_game$Label[p]))))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}


```
